subject: Acme Corp - Evaluation kickoff scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme discovery follow-up & next steps

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from our discovery: 

- Primary goal: reduce latency and inference cost for Acme's customer-facing summarization feature while preserving quality at peak traffic.
- Success metrics: P95 latency < 400ms, per-1000-token cost reduction >= 30%, and end-to-end quality score >= 92 on your prompt set.
- Technical constraints: must run within Acme's AWS account for the private deployment; data residency in US.

Next steps I proposed on the call: schedule an Evaluation Kickoff where we align on the trial plan, share the initial prompt set/evals, and confirm success criteria and roles. Connor (our solutions engineer) will cover integration approach and provide a technical checklist.

Proposed slots next week (PT):
- Mon 7/5, 10:00-11:00
- Tue 7/6, 14:00-15:00
- Wed 7/7, 09:00-10:00

If those don't work, share a couple times that do and we'll accommodate. I'll attach the draft evaluation plan and the NDA we discussed.

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Eval_Plan_v1.pdf, NDA_signed.pdf

Thanks Marissa — that recap is perfect. We're excited to move forward.

Attendees from our side: me (Sarah, product lead), Raj (infra/ops), and possibly one of our ML engineers (TBD). 

From the slots you proposed, Tue 7/6 14:00-15:00 PT works best for us. Could you share a short agenda so we can prep the team? Also please include any pre-reads or the prompt set so our ML engineer can review ahead of time.

Quick Q: will Connor cover the AWS private deployment checklist in the kickoff? We want to make sure IAM, networking, and KMS details are baked into the plan.

Thanks,

2) Trial plan overview (Marissa) — timeline, milestones, roles (10 min)
3) Technical checklist & integration approach (Connor) — VPC peering, IAM roles, KMS, network egress, and required endpoints (15 min)

5) Next steps & action items (5 min)

Attached: Redwood_Eval_Plan_v1.pdf (includes proposed prompt set, eval rubric, timeline) and NDA_signed.pdf. Connor — will you confirm the list of technical artifacts you'll need from Acme ahead of the meeting? I put a short pre-read section in the eval plan to help your ML engineer prep.
